name: io.github.bumbaRasch/searxng-mcp-server
title: SearXNG MCP Server
description: Self-hosted SearXNG metasearch for MCP clients: thirteen tools (web/image/news/video/music/paper search with citation refs and heuristic rerank, search_and_fetch, page fetch with SSRF guard and archive fallback, site crawling, suggestions, engine listing, instance doctor, deep-search dossier), observability resources, built-in skills, an MCP Apps gallery and io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks support.

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the SearXNG instance

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport: stdio (default) or http (Streamable HTTP, 2026-07-28 revision only)
